text:
Predicates:
Adores(x, y) ::: x adores y.
Style(y, z) ::: y is a style of z.
InterestingGeometries(y) ::: y has interesting geometries.
Brutalist(y) ::: y is a brutalist building.
ZahaStyle(y) ::: y is a style of Zaha Hadid.
KellyStyle(y) ::: y is a style of Kelly Wearstler.
Evocative(y) ::: y is evocative.
Dreamy(y) ::: y is dreamy.
Design(z) ::: z is a design by Max.
Build(z) ::: z is a building.
HasDesign(z, y) ::: z has design style y.
Predicates:
∃y (Style(y, zaha) ∧ Adores(max, y)) ::: Max adores some Zaha Hadid's style.
∀y (Adores(max, y) ∧ Style(y, zaha) → InterestingGeometries(y)) ::: All styles of Zaha Hadid that Max adores have interesting geometries.
∀y (Adores(max, y) ∧ Style(y, brutalist) → Brutalist(y)) ::: All styles of brutalist buildings that Max adores are brutalist.
∀y (Adores(max, y) ∧ Style(y, kelly) → (Evocative(y) ∧ Dreamy(y))) ::: All styles of Kelly Wearstler's that Max adores are evocative and dreamy.
∀z (HasDesign(z, y) ∧ Adores(max, y) ∧ InterestingGeometries(y) → (Brutalist(z) ∧ Evocative(z))) ::: If Max's design z has a style y he adores with interesting geometries, then z is a brutalist building and evocative.
Premises:
∃y (Style(y, zaha) ∧ Adores(max, y)) ::: Max adores some style of Zaha Hadid.
∀y (Adores(max, y) ∧ Style(y, zaha) → InterestingGeometries(y)) ::: All styles of Zaha Hadid that Max adores have interesting geometries.
∀y (Adores(max, y) ∧ Style(y, brutalist) → Brutalist(y)) ::: All styles of brutalist buildings that Max adores are brutalist.
∀y (Adores(max, y) ∧ Style(y, kelly) → (Evocative(y) ∧ Dreamy(y))) ::: All styles of Kelly Wearstler's that Max adores are evocative and dreamy.
Conclusion:
∃z (HasDesign(z, y) ∧ Adores(max, y) ∧ InterestingGeometries(y) → (Brutalist(z) ∧ Evocative(z))) ::: If Max has a design with a style y he adores and y has interesting geometries, then z is a brutalist building.
